title: ON.energy full-window hero
description: A full-window hero over full-bleed media: a big weight-300 headline at mid-height on the left, a small lede in the bottom-left corner and a yellow promo card with a square thumbnail in the bottom-right (full width at the bottom on phones). As it scrolls away the media drifts down 300px and a veil of the page colour fades in.
notes: media slot: a video or image that covers the window; empty, a muted gradient stands in
made for a dark backdrop: the headline uses the foreground colour over the media
CSS only (view timeline); off under reduced motion
name: on-energy-hero
